cards.text: Ezekiel, a priest living among the exiles by the Kebar River (Ezekiel 1:1-3), tells this one himself. Some of the elders of Israel come over and sit down in front of him. Then the word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel.

cards.question: The LORD tells Ezekiel that these elders of Israel have set up idols. Where did they set them up?

cards.text: Not on a shelf, not in a corner, but in their HEARTS, with wicked stumbling blocks set right in front of their own faces. That's like parking the cookie cart in the doorway and then tripping over it every single morning.

cards.question: The LORD asks Ezekiel whether He should consult with these elders in any way.

cards.text: So the Lord GOD gives Ezekiel a message for them. When any Israelite with idols in his heart comes to the prophet, the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry.

cards.question: Why does the LORD say He will answer that man according to his great idolatry?

answers.text: To take hold of Israel's hearts

cards.question: Because of their idols, how many of the people of Israel does the LORD say are estranged from Him?

cards.text: So what's the fix? Ezekiel is told to take a message from the Lord GOD to the house of Israel.

cards.question: The Lord GOD tells the house of Israel: ___ and turn away from your idols.

cards.text: And turn their faces away from all their abominations. That's me walking past the chocolate chips, staring at the ceiling like we've never met.
The Lord GOD's message keeps going. It's about anyone who separates himself from God, sets up idols in his heart, and then comes to the prophet to inquire of Him.

cards.question: Besides Israelites, the LORD's warning about idols in the heart also covers any foreigner living in Israel.

cards.text: That's like ghosting a friend for a whole year and then texting, "Hey, quick question." The LORD says He will answer that man Himself, and He will set His face against him.

cards.question: The LORD sets His face against the man who comes to the prophet with idols in his heart. What does He say He will make that man?
The LORD says He will cut that idol-hearted man off from among His people.

cards.text: Then God says, "Then you will know that I am the LORD." Now He turns to the prophet.

cards.question: In God's message, if a prophet is enticed to speak a message, who enticed him?
What does the LORD say He will do to the prophet who is enticed to speak?

answers.text: Stretch out His hand against him
Lift up His hand to bless him
Put new words in his mouth

cards.text: God says He will destroy that prophet from among His people Israel, and they will bear their punishment, the one who came asking and the prophet. This part is heavy.

cards.question: The LORD says the punishment of the one who came asking will be lighter than the prophet's punishment.
The LORD says He does all this so the house of Israel will keep its distance from Him.

cards.text: God says He does all this so the house of Israel will no longer stray from Him and no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions.

cards.question: And then, the Lord GOD says, they will be His ___ and He will be their ___.
